title: Completed open exchange agrees with the actual constant-coefficient strict mate
statement:
Let $(A,I)$ be the Noetherian adic datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with finite perfect quotients $P_n=A/I^n$, completed ring sheaves $A_V=\lim_n(P_n)_V$, and strict quotient towers. Let $(j:U\hookrightarrow T,j':U'\hookrightarrow T',u:T'\to T,v:U'\to U)$ be a cartesian open square, with $j$ quasi-compact [def-cbc-open-immersion-square, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use exact localized ringed extension by zero [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_U))$ be intrinsically derived $I$-complete [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. Assume $j_!K$ is complete and identify $(j_!K)_\bullet\cong J_jK_\bullet$ by the canonical open-tensor quotient comparisons.
Let $r_V$ be restriction along $\underline A_V\to A_V$ and use the canonical finite-reduction and derived-limit identifications, including completion units, of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Put $M=r_UK_\bullet$ and use the constant-ring operations $G_u,G_v,J_j,J_{j'}$ of [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations, def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]. Set $N=G_uJ_jM$ and $N'=J_{j'}G_vM$. Let $Q=Lu^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}(j_!K)_\bullet$ and $Q'=J_{j'}Lv^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}K_\bullet$, using the derived strict-tower pullback of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback].
Let $\omega_K$ be the actual strict finite open exchange of [lem-cbc-completed-ring-strict-finite-exchange], with source transported by the assumed quotient identification. Thus the finite open exchanges, whose inverses are the transposes of the pulled-back open units, give the specified natural isomorphism $\omega_K:Q\xrightarrow{\sim}Q'$ in the derived category of strict $A_{T'}$-towers. This construction uses the finite unit maps on strict representatives with their quotient transitions [lem-cbc-finite-open-exchange-scalars]. Under the specified scalar and finite-reduction comparisons $a:r_{T'}Q\simeq N$, $b:r_{T'}Q'\simeq N'$, it satisfies
$$b\circ r_{T'}(\omega_K)=\beta_{j,u,M}\circ a,$$
where $\beta$ is the constant-$A$ strict open unit-mate of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. This is an equality of strict-tower derived morphisms before evaluation.
Let $\beta_K^{\mathrm{comp}}:Lu^*_{\mathrm{comp}}j_!K\to j'_!Lv^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K$ be the canonical completed comparison induced by these finite exchanges and the extension/limit comparison [lem-cbc-completed-extension-zero-comparison]. Write $L_V$ for constant-$A$ total derived inverse limit and $\lambda_{j'}:j'_!L_{U'}\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{T'}J_{j'}$ for the specified normalized comparison of [lem-cbc-exact-product-functor-strict-limit]. Under the canonical coefficient and finite-reduction endpoint identifications, the ordered comparison satisfies
$$r_{T'}(\beta_K^{\mathrm{comp}})=\lambda_{j'}^{-1}\circ L_{T'}(\beta_{j,u,M}).$$
All assertions are natural in $K$; evaluation of the already specified $\omega_K$ gives the finite open exchange at each $n$. No etale-origin witnesses, common lower bound, or faithfulness of derived evaluation is assumed.
